eligibility.recordedBy_policy: use as cluster if nonmissing on >=90% of otherwise eligible events; otherwise cluster by 0.5-degree analysis cell

response.value: 1 if >=2 distinct scientificName records share eventID; 0 if exactly 1
response.name: multi_species_recording
response.presence_only_boundary: 0 means one identified calling species in that submitted recording, not biological absence of other frogs

rainfall_exposure.window: three complete calendar days before eventDate: D-3 through D-1
rainfall_exposure.value: sum of SILO daily_rain mm at nearest 0.05-degree grid cell
rainfall_exposure.reason: avoid using rainfall that may have occurred after the recording on eventDate
rainfall_exposure.transform: log1p(rain3_mm), demean within fixed 0.5-degree analysis cell, then global z-score

analysis_cell.definition: floor latitude and longitude to fixed 0.5-degree bins
analysis_cell.role: remove persistent spatial differences in baseline rainfall regime and frog richness without selecting regions by outcome

model.support_rule: beta > 0, two-sided cluster-robust p < 0.05, 95% CI excludes 0

sensitivities.name: ge3_species
sensitivities.response: 1 if >=3 distinct species in eventID, else 0

sensitivities.name: one_recording_per_user_day
sensitivities.filter: deterministically keep lexicographically smallest eventID within recordedBy x eventDate

forbidden: changing the 3-day rainfall window after opening
selecting a state or species pair after opening
choosing a coordinate-uncertainty cutoff other than 3000 m primary / 1000 m sensitivity
substituting temperature if rainfall validation is null
claiming FrogID single-species recordings prove other species were absent
